title: Market shares
text:
Market shares

Market share details supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

The format of the 
UNICEDE
/2 file is slightly different to permit the importing of market
 shares. Sums insured, number of risks, and premiums must be imported separately using the
 standard 
File body
 format.

Note:

 You can include records from multiple supported countries in one file by
 using 
Data levels
 and 
Area tag type
 98 or 99 in the 
UNICEDE/2 file header
.

| Field | Name | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | AreaTag | Identifies the area (i.e., country) and the subarea (e.g., county or CRESTA zone) in which the risks represented in this record are located. | The AreaTag value used must be consistent with the AreaTagType from the UNICEDE/2 file header . |
| 2 | PerilCode | Identifies the peril covered for the risks in this record. | Note: The data in the fields that follow should represent this peril. Data
 for different perils should be reported separately in different
 records. |
| 3 | LOBCode | Identifies the line of business under which the risks covered in this
 record are reported. | The valid Line Of Business codes vary by country. When reviewing the codes
 for a specific country, please note that the available lines of business are
 sometimes different for Market Share imports. |
| 4 | Coverage | Identifies the coverages included for the risks in this record. | When importing market share data, the coverage code should be set to MS . |
| 5 | NumRisks | When importing market shares, this field displays the market share value. | This value must be entered in whole units (i.e., not in thousands or
 millions). |
| 6 | SumsIns | N/A | When importing market share data, this will be 0 . |
| 7 | AvgDed | N/A | When importing market share data, this will be 0 . |
| 8 | Prem | N/A | When importing market share data, this will be 0 . |
| 9 | PremRate | N/A | When importing market share data, this will be 0 . |
| 10 | SubareaName | This is the name of the area (i.e., country) or subarea. | This is an optional field. Including this field improves the chances of
 detecting and fixing errors in the AreaTag field. |

Note:
 
Updated market share 
UNICEDE
2 files can be found on the
 
Verisk

Client Support
 website at 
www.air-worldwide.com
. Prior to 
CATRADER
 version 8.0, Market Share imports were
 supported ONLY for the U.S. and Canada.

For example, a 
UNICEDE
2 file importing market shares for the U.S. could contain rows that
 look like this:

 01-02000,PWS,RES,MS,100,0,0,0,0,Florida

 01-02000,PWS,MO,MS,100,0,0,0,0,Florida

 01-02000,PWS,COM,MS,100,0,0,0,0,Florida

 01-02000,PWS,AUTO,MS,100,0,0,0,0,Florida

 

In Turkey, the data could look like this:

 38-1,PEQ,BLD,MS,10,0,0,0,0,0,Adana

 38-1,PEQ,CNT,MS,10,0,0,0,0,0,Adana 

 38-2,PEQ,COM,MS,10,0,0,0,0,0,Adiyaman

 38-2,PEQ,CNT,MS,10,0,0,0,0,0,Adiyaman

rows: AreaTag
Identifies the area (i.e., country) and the subarea (e.g., county or CRESTA zone) in which the risks represented in this record are located.
The AreaTag value used must be consistent with the AreaTagType from the UNICEDE/2 file header .
PerilCode
Identifies the peril covered for the risks in this record.

Note: The data in the fields that follow should represent this peril. Data
                     for different perils should be reported separately in different
                     records.
LOBCode

Identifies the line of business under which the risks covered in this
                     record are reported.

The valid Line Of Business codes vary by country. When reviewing the codes
                     for a specific country, please note that the available lines of business are
                     sometimes different for Market Share imports.
Coverage
Identifies the coverages included for the risks in this record.
When importing market share data, the coverage code should be set to MS .
NumRisks
When importing market shares, this field displays the market share value.

This value must be entered in whole units (i.e., not in thousands or
                     millions).
SumsIns
N/A
When importing market share data, this will be 0 .
AvgDed
N/A
When importing market share data, this will be 0 .
Prem
N/A
When importing market share data, this will be 0 .
PremRate
N/A
When importing market share data, this will be 0 .
SubareaName
This is the name of the area (i.e., country) or subarea.

This is an optional field. Including this field improves the chances of
                     detecting and fixing errors in the AreaTag field.
